svg.aria-label: Remold: animated components for your UI, and the primitives to build your own. Change you can follow. A list sorted newest first is re-sorted A to Z, with a line following each row to where it went, over particles streaming from a loose cloud into a neat grid. Around it float a revenue card, a save button turning from Saving to Saved, an avatar stack, and a dotted globe.
